title: Breeze
tagline: Breeze is a real-time anonymous chat on World App, connecting you with random people securely.
description:
Breeze is a real-time anonymous chat application designed to facilitate meaningful and spontaneous conversations between users. The app connects individuals with random people from around the world, providing a unique space for people to interact without the constraints of identity or social networks. Whether you're looking to chat with someone for fun, discuss ideas, or simply engage in casual conversation, Breeze enables a dynamic, anonymous environment that encourages openness and connection.

The user interface is designed with simplicity and ease of use in mind, offering a clean and modern layout that prioritizes smooth navigation and interaction. Breeze’s minimalistic design ensures users can focus on the conversation without distractions, making it easy to start chatting right away.

One of the core features of Breeze is its integration of World ID verification, which enhances both security and authenticity. This ensures that users are verified through the Worldcoin ecosystem, adding a layer of trust and legitimacy to the otherwise anonymous nature of the app. World ID helps mitigate the risk of spam and malicious activity, ensuring a safer and more trustworthy experience for all users.

In terms of functionality, Breeze uses WebSockets to establish real-time communication between users, ensuring seamless, lag-free interactions. This technology enables instant message delivery, allowing users to engage in live conversations that feel natural and fluid. The real-time aspect is crucial for the app’s goal of creating meaningful connections, as it fosters an environment where users can share thoughts and ideas without delays.

Overall, Breeze offers an exciting new way for people to meet and interact with others in an anonymous yet secure setting, providing a fresh approach to online communication. By combining cutting-edge technologies like World ID and WebSockets with a sleek, user-friendly design, Breeze is transforming the way we connect with strangers around the world.
how_its_made: I built the front-end of the project using the Next.js framework, which provided a solid and flexible foundation for creating a fast, modern user interface. To integrate the app as a Mini App on World App, I utilized Worldcoin's MiniKit, allowing for seamless World ID authentication and smooth interaction within the World App ecosystem. For real-time communication, I implemented a WebSocket server using JavaScript, enabling instant, anonymous chats between users. This combination of technologies ensured a secure, scalable, and interactive experience for users.
